recipe.visualDefinition: A four-person ensemble portrait set against a soft cyan-to-yellow sky gradient. The subjects are styled in textured, warm-toned apparel (faux fur, floral prints, suede) and positioned from the waist up. The typography is centered in the upper third, featuring a high-contrast, modern serif with sharp terminals.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm-toned subjects against a cool-to-neutral gradient background
Textured clothing (fur/suede) contrasting with smooth digital sky
Large display serif anchored above the group's heads
Symmetrical group arrangement with varied heights
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused lighting with minimal harsh shadows
Cyan-blue upper background transitioning to a pale yellow horizon

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged horizontally across the lower two-thirds of the frame, medium-shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central display text in the upper third acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large white text, move down to the central figures, then scan outward to the flanking members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space in the top third to accommodate large-scale typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in clothing against a desaturated, high-value background gradient.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thin hairlines and thick stems
Large x-height for the display face
characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular dot on the 'i' or period
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for drama paired with a wide-tracked sans-serif for modern stability.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp serifs and extreme stroke variation.
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a four-person music group (two men, two women) standing in a row. Style them in 70s-inspired textures: one woman in a bright orange shaggy faux-fur coat, one woman in a floral dress, one man in a tan satin shirt, and one man in a burnt orange suede jacket. The background is a clean, soft gradient from cyan blue at the top to pale yellow at the bottom. Lighting is bright and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered white text in the upper third. The top line should be a large, high-contrast modern serif. The second line should be a small, all-caps geometric sans-serif with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the background a smooth cyan-to-yellow gradient?
Is the orange fur coat the most vibrant element?
Is the display text a high-contrast serif?
Is the secondary text widely tracked and all-caps?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists
Original band name and album title text
Any specific brand logos on clothing

mustAchieve: Balanced color palette of warm vs cool

postGenerationChecks: Verify the orange fur texture is prominent
Confirm the sky gradient is smooth without banding
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble portrait + Warm/Cool contrast + High-contrast Didone typography + Wide-tracked Sans-serif subtitle.
